title: Capstone 03 — Real-Time Voice Assistant (ASR to LLM to TTS)

questions.question: What is the simulated frame cadence in `synth_call`?
options: One `Frame` every 20 ms
One `Frame` every 100 ms
One `Frame` per spoken word
A variable cadence chosen by the TTS stream
questions.explanation: Each generated frame advances `t` by 20 milliseconds. Six initial frames therefore represent 120 ms of leading silence before the simulated utterance.

questions.question: What score does `turn_completion_score` return for a partial ending in `?`, `.`, or `!`?
questions.explanation: The punctuation branch returns 0.95 before the word-count heuristic runs, making an explicitly punctuated partial strongly likely to be complete.

questions.question: When does `run_session` mark a listening turn complete?
options: After any single silent frame
When the partial has punctuation, regardless of VAD silence
After at least 500 ms of silence and a completion score of at least 0.6
Only after the weather tool returns
questions.explanation: The scheduler accumulates 20-ms silent frames until `silence_run_ms >= 500`, then requires `turn_completion_score(final_partial) >= 0.6` before entering `WAITING`.

questions.question: What does the tool side-channel emit after the weather call has been pending for 300 ms?
options: A second ASR transcript
An immediate TTS cancellation
A fatal timeout and session reset
The filler `one second, let me check`
questions.explanation: The scheduler emits the filler once the pending tool exceeds 300 ms, keeping the audio stream conversational while `WEATHER` completes at 420 ms.

questions.question: What latency does the clean demo report from turn completion to first audio?
options: 740 ms
560 ms
420 ms
180 ms
questions.explanation: The clean trace records turn completion at 2840 ms and first audio at 3580 ms. `Metrics.latency_ms()` subtracts those timestamps, yielding 740 ms.

questions.question: What state change does the second demo make when speech arrives during the response?
options: It waits for TTS to finish and stays SPEAKING
It counts one barge-in, cancels the TTS/LLM stream, and re-arms LISTENING
It marks the turn as a false cutoff without changing state
It switches to TOOL and keeps the old audio buffer
questions.explanation: The barge-in branch fires while SPEAKING or THINKING, increments `barge_ins`, logs cancellation, resets stream timestamps, and sets the state to LISTENING.
